processing.name: AI-assisted customer churn and next-best-action model

items.text: Purpose: rank customers by predicted churn and recommend a retention offer via the marketing platform
Data controller: the bank; processing operated by Retail Marketing with a model vendor as processor
Personal data: customer identifiers, product holdings, transaction aggregates, channel engagement
Financial-vulnerability indicator is sensitive under the synthetic institution policy; no GDPR Article 9 category is inferred.
Lawful basis: legitimate interests for churn scoring, with a documented balancing test; opt-out honored
Necessity/proportionality evidence is supplied for reviewer assessment; no special-category condition is asserted.
Recipients: analytics vendor (processor) under a data-processing agreement; no onward sale
International transfer to a third-country vendor covered by standard contractual clauses + transfer risk assessment
Scores retained 13 months then deleted; training data pseudonymized after model refresh
Retention aligned to the records-retention schedule; deletion routine tested
Encryption in transit and at rest; role-based access; vendor SOC 2 Type II reviewed
Pseudonymization of training data; access logging and monitoring in place
Transparency: privacy notice updated to describe scoring and the retention offer; no solely-automated decision with legal effect
Rights: access, rectification, erasure, objection to profiling, and opt-out supported operationally
Sensitive proxy access restricted and separately approved; human review before any adverse retention action
Bias/fairness evaluation scheduled; opt-out suppression enforced at scoring time
